design:
Actors: the final W2 fixed-actor weights (run 0) of GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6.1 Terra on the six
ablation families (ztl lys esm ruz crg mds), i.e. the 18 initialisations of Stage 2.

matched_random.note: random direction with the support and per-tensor norms of each actor's update (finite checkpoints only), mean of 2 seeds
random direction with the support and per-tensor norms of each actor's update (finite checkpoints only), mean of 2 seeds

sp_16k.note: critic warm-up: the actor optimiser is not stepped while steps_before < 50000, so theta is identical to theta_0 at the 16k and 41k checkpoints (by construction of wsp.train_ppo.ppo)

matched_seed0_sparse.note: final students (303k) of the seed-0 sparse runs that did not diverge; student scores from their exact eval.json restricted to the Q-lvl subsample; matched = random direction with the student update's support and per-tensor norms (2 seeds)

rl_line: Standard PPO, first ckpt 16k (18 actors): relative update 9.4e-05 overall (median; 2.0e-02 in the most-changed tensor), held-out Q-lvl 0.04 (init 0.51), S-start 0.08 (init 0.70); random update of the same size and support: Q-lvl 0.06, S-start 0.07; Structure-preserving PPO, first ckpt after warm-up 82k (3 actors): relative update 2.0e-05 overall (median; 2.5e-02 in the most-changed tensor), held-out Q-lvl 0.26 (init 0.91), S-start 0.42 (init 1.00); random update of the same size and support: Q-lvl 0.11, S-start 0.18; SGD, lr 1e-5, final 303k (18 actors): relative update 4.2e-08 overall (median; 1.5e-05 in the most-changed tensor), held-out Q-lvl 0.29 (init 0.51), S-start 0.33 (init 0.70); random update of the same size and support: Q-lvl 0.27, S-start 0.31; Structure-preserving PPO, final 303k (17 actors): relative update 1.4e-05 overall (median; 4.2e-02 in the most-changed tensor), held-out Q-lvl 0.10 (init 0.50), S-start 0.17 (init 0.69); random update of the same size and support: Q-lvl 0.07, S-start 0.11; SGD at its first checkpoint (16k): relative update <= 8.7e-07 overall (exact bound from gradient clipping, 64 steps x lr 1e-5 x 0.5); Structure-preserving PPO at 16k and 41k: actor unchanged (critic warm-up to 50k steps).
